summary: van Hoften describes the mod p points of Shimura varieties of Hodge type at parahoric level: isogeny classes via restricted local shtukas and affine Deligne–Lusztig varieties, CM lifts of every isogeny class, and connected components of EKOR strata, with Appendix A (with Zhou) on connected components of ADLVs in the non-basic case. Complete (cc-442dc5): every numbered statement is an item, every missing item is routed exactly once, and thirty-four findings are recorded. After review, ten slips affect nothing; the §2.1 perfect-space arguments, the Hoff23 import (E33) and several appendix steps have recorded proof gaps, and E17 affects a stated result. Not formalised.

items.statement: For a characteristic-p algebraic space Y0, Y0^perf is the inverse limit along absolute Frobenius, with its projection to Y0; a perfect space has invertible Frobenius. Work over a perfect field k.

items.name: Quotient dimension formula
items.statement: If Y→[X/G] is weakly perfectly smooth of relative dimension n, X is equidimensional of dimension d, and G is a pfp perfect group, then Y is equidimensional of dimension d+n−dim G, in the pfp setting of the lemma.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Full fixer versus connected parahoric
items.statement: For a bounded facet of the building, distinguish its smooth full pointwise-fixer group scheme from its identity-component parahoric model. In this paper a connected parahoric means these two models coincide.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.R01.mk
api.statement: Supply a facet and its two stabilizer models.

api.name: VanHoften24.R01.characterisation
api.statement: Equality means absence of the component quotient of the full fixer.

api.name: VanHoften24.R01.map
api.statement: Nested facets induce the prescribed inclusions of integral groups.

uses.where: §2.2.1 pp11–12; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/R02, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/R03, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/R04, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/G01, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S06, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M01, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M12, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/R06, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C07
uses.how: Nested facets induce the prescribed inclusions of integral groups.

items.name: Torsion-free inertia ensures connected fixer
items.statement: If pi1(G)_I is torsion-free, the full fixer of every relevant facet is its connected parahoric.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Connectedness for a smaller parahoric
items.statement: If J⊂K and the K-parahoric is connected in the full-fixer sense, so is the J-parahoric.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Very special parahoric
items.statement: For quasi-split G/Qp choose a sigma-stable alcove and a sigma-stable special vertex in its closure whose parahoric K has WK≃W0; the Iwahori is contained in K.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.R04.mk
api.statement: Choose the vertex and its sigma-stable parahoric.

api.name: VanHoften24.R04.characterisation
api.statement: The projection WK→W0 is an isomorphism.

api.name: VanHoften24.R04.map
api.statement: Levi intersection with a very special parahoric is very special for the standard Levi.

uses.where: §2.2.5 p12; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S13, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M17, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M24, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/V01
uses.how: Levi intersection with a very special parahoric is very special for the standard Levi.

items.name: Iwahori–Weyl group and length-zero part
items.statement: The extended affine Weyl group fits 1→X_*(T)_I→Wtilde→W0→1 and Wtilde=Waff⋊Omega, with Omega≃pi1(G)_I and length zero. Retain sigma and the chosen alcove.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.R05.mk
api.statement: Form the normalizer quotient by the connected torus parahoric.

api.name: VanHoften24.R05.characterisation
api.statement: Affine and length-zero factors uniquely describe an element.

api.name: VanHoften24.R05.map
api.statement: Group homomorphisms and sigma preserve the specified root-data comparisons.

uses.where: §2.2.5 pp12–13; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/G05, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/R06, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/V01, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A08, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/R07
uses.how: Group homomorphisms and sigma preserve the specified root-data comparisons.

items.name: Witt loop groups
items.statement: For a parahoric model Gcal/Zp and a perfect Fp-algebra R, LG(R)=G(W(R)[1/p]), L+Gcal(R)=Gcal(W(R)), and LmGcal(R)=Gcal(W(R)/p^m); all maps use Witt functoriality.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.G01.mk
api.statement: Construct the three group-valued functors and truncation maps.

api.name: VanHoften24.G01.characterisation
api.statement: Integral loops are the positive-loop subgroup of generic loops.

api.name: VanHoften24.G01.map
api.statement: Perfect-algebra maps and model morphisms induce compatible loop maps.

uses.where: §2.2.6 pp13–14; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/G02, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/G03, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/G04, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S06, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S09, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A11
uses.how: Perfect-algebra maps and model morphisms induce compatible loop maps.

items.name: Witt affine flags
items.statement: The étale sheaf LG/L+Gcal is represented by the ind-perfect affine flag space Gr_K and is ind-perfectly projective for the parahoric situation used here.

items.name: Torsor modification description
items.statement: Gr_K(R) classifies a Gcal-torsor E over W(R) and a trivialization beta:E[1/p]≃E0[1/p], with isomorphisms respecting beta. This is sheafified; raw cosets need not describe every R-point.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.G03.mk
api.statement: Construct a modification from a torsor and rational trivialization.

api.name: VanHoften24.G03.characterisation
api.statement: Two modifications agree iff there is an integral isomorphism respecting the trivializations.

api.name: VanHoften24.G03.map
api.statement: Pull back the torsor and beta along perfect-algebra maps.

uses.where: §2.2.7 p14; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S01, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/X01
uses.how: Pull back the torsor and beta along perfect-algebra maps.

items.name: Witt torsors and loop torsors
items.statement: Gcal-torsors on Spec W(R) are étale locally trivial after a cover of Spec R and correspond to L+Gcal-torsors on the perfect étale site.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Admissible Schubert union
items.statement: Adm({mu}) consists of w≤t^(x mu) for some x∈W0. The bounded parahoric local-model special fiber is the reduced union of Schubert varieties for the image of Adm in WK / Wtilde/WK; for Iwahori use Bruhat order.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.G05.mk
api.statement: Construct the finite admissible index set and reduced union.

api.name: VanHoften24.G05.characterisation
api.statement: Membership is an existential Bruhat inequality against Weyl translates.

api.name: VanHoften24.G05.map
api.statement: Projection to a coarser parahoric respects the union.

uses.where: §2.2.14–2.2.15 pp15–16; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/G06, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/G07, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S08, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S09, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S15, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S21, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/X01, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M02, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M27, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C09
uses.how: Projection to a coarser parahoric respects the union.

items.name: Schubert normality and dimension
items.statement: Iwahori Schubert varieties in the Witt flag space are normal, have cell dimension ell(w), and closure the union of cells indexed by v≤w.

items.name: Minuscule local-model dimension
items.statement: For minuscule mu the admissible local-model special fiber is equidimensional of dimension <2rho,mu>.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Local Hecke stack
items.statement: Hk_G,K(R) is the groupoid of two Gcal-torsors over W(R) with an isomorphism after inverting p. It is the quotient [L+Gcal / Gr_K] with the specified left action.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.S01.mk
api.statement: Construct the two torsors and rational modification.

api.name: VanHoften24.S01.characterisation
api.statement: Trivializing the target gives a flag point modulo its positive-loop changes of frame.

api.name: VanHoften24.S01.map
api.statement: Pull back modifications and compose when source and target agree.

uses.where: §2.2.9 p14; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S02
uses.how: Pull back modifications and compose when source and target agree.

items.name: Perfect local shtuka
items.statement: A Gcal-shtuka over a perfect algebra R is a Gcal-torsor E on W(R) with beta:sigma*E[1/p]≃E[1/p]. Isomorphisms intertwine beta.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.S02.mk
api.statement: Supply the torsor and Frobenius modification.

api.name: VanHoften24.S02.characterisation
api.statement: In a frame beta is b and changing frame by h gives h^(-1)b sigma(h).

api.name: VanHoften24.S02.map
api.statement: Base change carries both E and beta, with the Frobenius comparison.

uses.where: §2.2.10 pp14–15; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S03, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S04, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S07, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/B03, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/X01, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/X04, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M05
uses.how: Base change carries both E and beta, with the Frobenius comparison.

items.name: Local shtuka quotient
items.statement: The stack of perfect local Gcal-shtukas is [LG/Ad_sigma L+Gcal], where the frame-change relation is b~h^(-1)b sigma(h).
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Height-one local shtuka
items.statement: For GLn, an integral height-one local shtuka is a finite projective W(R)-module M with Frobenius satisfying pM⊂beta(sigma*M)⊂M. Use the contravariant Dieudonné convention.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.S04.mk
api.statement: Supply M,beta and the two lattice inclusions.

api.name: VanHoften24.S04.characterisation
api.statement: Height and dimension are read from the cokernel of beta.

api.name: VanHoften24.S04.map
api.statement: Pull back along perfect R-maps while preserving the inclusions.

uses.where: §2.2.10 p15; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S05
uses.how: Pull back along perfect R-maps while preserving the inclusions.

items.name: Gabber–Lau classification
items.statement: Over perfect rings, height-one local GLn-shtukas classify p-divisible groups through the contravariant Dieudonné equivalence in the range used by the paper.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Change of parahoric on classifying stacks
items.statement: For J⊂K, B(L+G_J)→B(L+G_K) is represented by the perfect flag variety of the reductive quotient of G_K modulo the parabolic image of G_J.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Unbounded level-change fiber
items.statement: The unbounded shtuka level-change map Sht_J→Sht_K is the pullback of B(L+G_J)→B(L+G_K) along the underlying torsor map.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Bounded level change is perfectly proper
items.statement: For J⊂K and a fixed conjugacy class {mu}, Sht_J,mu→Sht_K,mu is representable and perfectly proper. The bounded square with the unbounded level maps need not be Cartesian.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Infinite and reductively truncated local models
items.statement: Let M_K^infinity be the inverse image of M_K^loc in LG. Let M_K^(1,rdt) be its quotient by the kernel of L+G_K→G_K^rdt on the specified side. It is a G_K^rdt-torsor over M_K^loc.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.S09.mk
api.statement: Take the inverse image and then the congruence-kernel quotient.

api.name: VanHoften24.S09.characterisation
api.statement: The reductive quotient torsor records one frame modulo the pro-unipotent kernel.

api.name: VanHoften24.S09.map
api.statement: Changing the truncation respects projection to the local model.

uses.where: §2.3.1 pp16–17; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S10, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S11, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S13, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S20
uses.how: Changing the truncation respects projection to the local model.

items.name: Finite-level factorization of the twisted action
items.statement: For m sufficiently large relative to mu, the twisted L+G_K-action on M_K^(1,rdt) factors through LmG_K as an action, including its identity and associativity laws.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Restricted local shtuka stack
items.statement: For m with the action factorization, define Sht_K,mu^(m,1)=[M_K^(1,rdt)/Ad_sigma LmG_K]. Its map to [M_K^loc/G_K] retains the reductive-frame and truncated-frame torsors.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.S11.mk
api.statement: Choose an admissible truncation m and form the action groupoid quotient.

api.name: VanHoften24.S11.characterisation
api.statement: Objects are the bounded frame datum modulo truncated sigma-conjugacy.

api.name: VanHoften24.S11.map
api.statement: Increasing m gives transition morphisms compatible with the untruncated shtuka map.

uses.where: §2.3.1 and Remark2.3.2 pp17–18; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S12, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S14, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S21, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/X06, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M07, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M08
uses.how: Increasing m gives transition morphisms compatible with the untruncated shtuka map.

items.name: Restricted stack dimension
items.statement: If M_K^loc has dimension d, Sht_K,mu^(m,1) has dimension d+dim(G_K^rdt)−dim(LmG_K).
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Iwahori truncation correspondence
items.statement: For an Iwahori I⊂K very special, let gamma:L+I→B be the reduction to the Borel image in G_K^rdt and Hm the image of L+I in LmG_K. Form the quotient correspondence using ker gamma / M_I^infinity and Hm.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.S13.mk
api.statement: Specify the Borel reduction, Hm and both quotient maps.

api.name: VanHoften24.S13.characterisation
api.statement: The kernel and image data determine the correspondence without a fictitious restricted forgetful map.

api.name: VanHoften24.S13.map
api.statement: Cofinal truncations induce compatible correspondences.

uses.where: §2.3.3 pp18–19; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S14, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S15, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S16, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S17, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S18, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/S19
uses.how: Cofinal truncations induce compatible correspondences.

items.name: Cartesian restricted correspondence
items.statement: For m sufficiently large, the Iwahori-to-K bounded shtuka square of Proposition2.3.4 with its intermediate quotient correspondence is Cartesian as a square of groupoid stacks.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Outer parahoric square
items.statement: The square of reduced bounded local-model inverse images for I⊂K occurring in Lemma2.3.5 is Cartesian.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Correspondence dimension equality
items.statement: The two quotient stacks in Lemma2.3.6 have equal dimension, computed from the local-model dimension and the reductive/truncated group dimensions.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Equal-band gerbe comparison
items.statement: In the proof of Proposition2.3.4, the comparison of the two gerbes is an equivalence because it identifies their bands and is locally nonempty; a general morphism of gerbes need not be an equivalence.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Cofinality of congruence kernels
items.statement: For each prescribed mprime there is m sufficiently large such that ker(L+I→Hm) lies in ker(L+I→Lmprime I), yielding the required truncation comparison.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Weak smoothness of the correspondence
items.statement: For cofinal m,mprime, [ker gamma / M_I^infinity/Hm]→Sht_I,mu^(mprime,1) is weakly perfectly smooth.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: General restricted local shtukas
items.statement: For n≥2 and m sufficiently large, quotient the n-truncated local-model frame space M_K^n by the factored LmG_K twisted action to obtain Sht_K,mu^(m,n),loc. Keep this separate from reductive n=1 truncation.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.S20.mk
api.statement: Supply the n-level frame torsor and an m factoring its action.

api.name: VanHoften24.S20.characterisation
api.statement: Its quotient agrees with the indicated (m,n) local-shtuka functor.

api.name: VanHoften24.S20.map
api.statement: Maps from full shtukas commute with increasing m and decreasing n in the admissible range.

uses.where: §2.3.10 p22; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M07
uses.how: Maps from full shtukas commute with increasing m and decreasing n in the admissible range.

items.name: EKOR index poset
items.statement: The geometric points of the restricted shtuka stack are indexed by the left-minimal representatives ^K Adm({mu}), with the sigma-twisted partial order preceq of SYZ. Closed subsets are downward unions.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.S21.mk
api.statement: Construct minimal representatives and the twisted order using the parahoric Weyl subgroup.

api.name: VanHoften24.S21.characterisation
api.statement: A union of strata is closed exactly for the source downward-closed index sets.

api.name: VanHoften24.S21.map
api.statement: Forgetful level maps compare indices via the source correspondence.

uses.where: §2.3.11 pp22–23; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M09, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C16
uses.how: Forgetful level maps compare indices via the source correspondence.

items.name: Reductive isocrystals and sigma-centralizers
items.statement: B(G) is the set of sigma-conjugacy classes b~g^(-1)b sigma(g). J_b is the Qp-group whose rational points are g with g^(-1)b sigma(g)=b. Translate inversion to the existing BG0 convention explicitly.

api.name: VanHoften24.B01.mk
api.statement: Construct the sigma-conjugacy class and the descended automorphism group.

api.name: VanHoften24.B01.characterisation
api.statement: Changing b by g^(-1)b sigma(g) identifies J_b with J_bprime by conjugation by g^(-1).

api.name: VanHoften24.B01.map
api.statement: Extension of structure group carries both the isocrystal and its automorphisms.

uses.where: §2.4.1 p23; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/B02, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/X01, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/X04, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M11, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/B04
uses.how: Extension of structure group carries both the isocrystal and its automorphisms.

items.name: Acceptable Newton classes
items.statement: B(G,{mu}) consists of classes with kappa([b]) equal to the image of mu in pi1(G)_Gamma and dominant Newton point bounded by the Galois average of mu. The order fixes kappa and increases the dominant Newton point.

api.name: VanHoften24.B02.mk
api.statement: Supply both the Kottwitz equality and Newton inequality.

api.name: VanHoften24.B02.characterisation
api.statement: Basic means the Newton cocharacter is central.

api.name: VanHoften24.B02.map
api.statement: The two invariants are compatible with group homomorphisms in the source range.

uses.where: §2.4.1 p23; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/B03, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/X07, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/R06, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C28, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A03, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A08, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A09, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A30
uses.how: The two invariants are compatible with group homomorphisms in the source range.

items.name: Newton semicontinuity for shtukas
items.statement: The locus of a bounded perfect local shtuka whose class lies below a given Newton class is closed; geometric classes are independent of the algebraically closed residue field chosen.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Affine Deligne–Lusztig variety
items.statement: X(mu,b)_K is the perfect sheaf of modifications gL+G_K with g^(-1)b sigma(g) lying in the bounded admissible double-coset union. The condition is étale local on perfect test rings.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.X01.mk
api.statement: Construct a modification and a bounded Frobenius datum.

api.name: VanHoften24.X01.characterisation
api.statement: In a trivialization the defining condition is the indicated sigma-conjugacy inequality.

api.name: VanHoften24.X01.map
api.statement: Level change and sigma-conjugacy transport act compatibly on the sheaf.

uses.where: §2.4.2 pp23–24; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/X02, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/X03, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/X07, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M18, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A01, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A30
uses.how: Level change and sigma-conjugacy transport act compatibly on the sheaf.

items.name: Representability of ADLV
items.statement: X(mu,b)_K is a perfect scheme locally perfectly of finite type, realized as a closed bounded-condition subfunctor of the quasi-isogeny modification functor in Lemma2.4.5.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Framed isocrystal diagram
items.statement: A framed object is an integral shtuka (E,beta1) and a rational isomorphism beta0:E[1/p]→E0[1/p] with beta1=beta0^(-1)b sigma(beta0). Forget beta1 to identify the unbounded functor with Gr_K.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.X03.mk
api.statement: Supply E and beta0; the equation uniquely reconstructs beta1.

api.name: VanHoften24.X03.characterisation
api.statement: For bprime=g^(-1)b sigma(g), transport beta0 to g^(-1)beta0.

api.name: VanHoften24.X03.map
api.statement: The construction commutes with base change and rational change of framing.

uses.where: Lemma2.4.5 pp23–24; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/X06, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A22
uses.how: The construction commutes with base change and rational change of framing.

items.name: Locally profinite automorphism sheaf
items.statement: F_b(R)={g∈LG(R):g^(-1)b sigma(g)=b}. On the pro-etale site it is the locally profinite group sheaf underline(J_b(Qp)), whose sections are continuous maps from the appropriate profinite test spaces.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.X04.mk
api.statement: Form the automorphism equalizer and its sheaf.

api.name: VanHoften24.X04.characterisation
api.statement: Identify the topology-sensitive sheaf with the sigma-centralizer rational group.

api.name: VanHoften24.X04.map
api.statement: Conjugacy transport identifies automorphism sheaves and their actions.

uses.where: Lemma2.4.6 pp24–25; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/X05
uses.how: Conjugacy transport identifies automorphism sheaves and their actions.

items.name: Pro-etale local quasi-isogeny triviality
items.statement: A family of local G-shtukas all of Newton class [b] admits a quasi-isogeny to the constant b-shtuka pro-etale locally; its sheaf of such quasi-isogenies is an F_b-torsor.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Newton stratum quotient
items.statement: In the pro-etale topology the bounded Newton stratum Sht_K,mu,[b] is equivalent to [F_b / X(mu,b)_K]; the quotient retains stabilizers.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: ADLV nonemptiness
items.statement: X(mu,b)_K is nonempty iff [b]∈B(G,{mu}); for nested parahorics the bounded ADLV projection is surjective on geometric points in the source range.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Kisin–Pappas integral Hodge model
items.statement: Under H, choose a good symplectic lattice realization of G_K. The integral model S_U(G,X) over O_E,(v) is the normalization of the closure of the generic Hodge Shimura variety in the associated Siegel model, with sufficiently small away-p level.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.M01.mk
api.statement: Supply the Hodge embedding, integral lattice and closure-normalization.

api.name: VanHoften24.M01.characterisation
api.statement: The generic fiber is the prescribed canonical Shimura model.

api.name: VanHoften24.M01.map
api.statement: Prime-to-p Hecke operators and allowed level changes extend to the integral models.

uses.where: §3.1.1–3.1.4 pp25–27; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M02, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M03, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M04, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M05, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M12, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M24, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A22
uses.how: Prime-to-p Hecke operators and allowed level changes extend to the integral models.

items.name: Local-model diagram
items.statement: Under H the model M01 admits a G_K-torsor q:S_tilde→S and a G_K-equivariant smooth map to the parahoric local model of relative dimension dim G; after perfection it gives lambda:S^perf→[M_K^loc/G_K].
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Hodge-embedding independence
items.statement: Under the integral-model hypotheses of Pap22 invoked here, M01 is independent of the chosen good Hodge embedding, compatibly with the canonical generic fiber.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Compatible realization tensors
items.statement: The defining tensors of the integral reductive group extend as de Rham tensors and rational ell-adic tensors for ell≠p, and give integral p-adic tensors on the generic fiber; at a special point obtain Frobenius-invariant contravariant Dieudonné tensors.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.M04.mk
api.statement: Construct Betti tensors and transfer them through the specified comparison maps.

api.name: VanHoften24.M04.characterisation
api.statement: Their stabilizer is the prescribed integral group in the Dieudonné frame.

api.name: VanHoften24.M04.map
api.statement: Specialization and isogenies compare tensors in the correct covariant or contravariant realization.

uses.where: §3.1.5–3.1.6 p27; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M05, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/D01, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M10, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A22, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A23, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A24
uses.how: Specialization and isogenies compare tensors in the correct covariant or contravariant realization.

items.name: Crystalline local shtuka map
items.statement: Under H, the p-divisible group and tensors define a canonical map Sh_K→Sht_K,{mu}, with mu=sigma(mu_h^(-1)). At the away-p tower the map is G(A_f^p)-equivariant with trivial action on the target.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.M05.mk
api.statement: Apply tensor Dieudonné theory to the universal abelian scheme over the perfect special fiber.

api.name: VanHoften24.M05.characterisation
api.statement: On a geometric point it gives the displayed tensor Frobenius module.

api.name: VanHoften24.M05.map
api.statement: Hodge-embedding and parahoric changes commute with the map through the canonical shtuka comparison.

uses.where: §3.1.6 p27; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M06, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M07
uses.how: Hodge-embedding and parahoric changes commute with the map through the canonical shtuka comparison.

items.name: Canonical diamond comparison
items.statement: The local shtuka from Hamacher–Kim/SYZ agrees with the special-fiber shtuka obtained from the canonical Pappas–Rapoport diamond construction, yielding independence and level functoriality.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Hoff infinitesimal tensor compatibility
items.statement: For the completed local model ring R_G and a_G=m_R_G²+m_E R_G, the canonical finite-free-module comparison of Hoff Lemma1.21 on W(R_G/a_G) is compatible with G-structures. This is an explicit input (Hoff Assumption2.28), not proved merely by naming the display.
items.locator: Hoff23 Assumption2.28 p25; consumed in vh24 §3.1.7
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Restricted shtuka smoothness
items.statement: Under H and the infinitesimal tensor-compatibility input D01 (or an independently proved replacement), Sh_K→Sht_K,mu^(m,1) and Sh_K→Sht_K,mu^(m,n),loc are perfectly smooth for admissible m and n≥2.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Commuting local-model morphism
items.statement: The restricted map from M07 composed with Sht_K,mu^(m,1)→[M_K^loc/G_K] equals the lambda map of M02 with the source action convention.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Global EKOR stratum
items.statement: For w∈^K Adm({mu}), define Sh_K{w} as the inverse image of the corresponding restricted-shtuka stratum. Its closed downward union is Sh_K{preceq w}.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.M09.mk
api.statement: Pull back the locally closed residual stratum at w.

api.name: VanHoften24.M09.characterisation
api.statement: Closure is the union indexed by wprime preceq w, using openness of M07.

api.name: VanHoften24.M09.map
api.statement: Prime-to-p Hecke maps preserve the stratification.

uses.where: §3.1.8 p28; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C13, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C28, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C29
uses.how: Prime-to-p Hecke maps preserve the stratification.

items.name: Tensor-preserving isogeny class
items.statement: Two special points x,xprime are in the same isogeny class if a quasi-isogeny A_x→A_xprime carries all ell-adic tensors in the forward direction and pulls crystalline tensors back from D_xprime[1/p] to D_x[1/p].
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.M10.mk
api.statement: Supply a quasi-isogeny with the two realization compatibilities.

api.name: VanHoften24.M10.characterisation
api.statement: Identity, inverse and composition give an equivalence relation.

api.name: VanHoften24.M10.map
api.statement: Changing integral level sends a class to the class of its image.

uses.where: §3.1.9 p29; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M11, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M13, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M14
uses.how: Changing integral level sends a class to the class of its image.

items.name: Rational tensor quasi-isogeny group
items.statement: I_x is the Q-group of quasi-automorphisms of A_x preserving the crystalline and all away-p realization tensors. It maps to J_b at p and to G(A_f^p) through the chosen frames.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.M11.mk
api.statement: Take the tensor stabilizer inside the quasi-endomorphism unit group.

api.name: VanHoften24.M11.characterisation
api.statement: The local maps are characterized by their realization actions.

api.name: VanHoften24.M11.map
api.statement: Changing x within its class conjugates I_x and transports the frames.

uses.where: §3.1.9 p29; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M18, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C19
uses.how: Changing x within its class conjugates I_x and transports the frames.

items.name: Proper parahoric transition
items.statement: For J⊂K, the canonical level-forgetting map S_J→S_K is proper and extends the generic transition map, with the chosen small away-p levels.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Same level fiber is one isogeny class
items.statement: All geometric points in a fiber of S_J→S_K belong to the same tensor-preserving isogeny class.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Preimage of an isogeny class
items.statement: The full inverse image under S_J→S_K of an isogeny class in S_K is a single isogeny class in S_J.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Shtuka and level compatibility
items.statement: The square of the perfect Shimura level transition and untruncated local-shtuka level transition commutes canonically.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Special point and integral reduction
items.statement: A special point is represented by a torus subdatum (T,h)→(G,X); choose its finite-field-of-definition integral extension and reduce it to the special fiber. A CM reduction is the image so obtained.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.M16.mk
api.statement: Supply the torus datum, generic point and integral extension.

api.name: VanHoften24.M16.characterisation
api.statement: The induced abelian variety has the corresponding CM tensor realization.

api.name: VanHoften24.M16.map
api.statement: Changing parahoric level commutes with integral extension and reduction.

uses.where: §3.2.1–3.2.2 pp31–32; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M17, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A28
uses.how: Changing parahoric level commutes with integral extension and reduction.

items.name: CM reductions at every parahoric
items.statement: Under H, every isogeny class at every parahoric level contains the reduction of a special point. No properness or unramifiedness assumption is added.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Isogeny uniformization parameters
items.statement: For x, form I_x(Q) / (X(mu,b)_K(Fpbar)×G(A_f^p)/U^p), with diagonal action through the p and away-p realizations. At the tower retain the right Hecke action and Phi=(b sigma)^r for the reflex residue degree r.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.M18.mk
api.statement: Construct the diagonal orbit set with specified realization maps.

api.name: VanHoften24.M18.characterisation
api.statement: The stabilizer and orbit relation include both coordinates.

api.name: VanHoften24.M18.map
api.statement: Local level projections and away-p right translations descend to the quotient.

uses.where: §3.3.1 pp32–33; AppendixA4; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M19, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M20, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M21, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M25, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C18, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A27
uses.how: Local level projections and away-p right translations descend to the quotient.

items.name: Cartesian square reduces uniformization
items.statement: If the perfect Shimura/local-shtuka level square for I⊂K very special is Cartesian at every small away-p level, the very-special isogeny uniformization induces Iwahori isogeny uniformization.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Uniformization respects the shtuka coordinate
items.statement: The uniformization morphism followed by the local-shtuka map is the projection to the ADLV coordinate followed by the Newton quotient.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Isogeny groupoid fiber product
items.statement: The fiber product in Lemma3.3.4 is the I_x(Q)-quotient of X(mu,b)_I×G(A_f^p)/U^p, using the common J_b-action and compatible quotient map.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Profinite Shimura component group
items.statement: Let pi(G) be the inverse limit over compact open U⊂G(A_f) of G(Q)_+ / G(A_f)/U. After quotienting by rho Gsc(A_f), use the induced abelian topological quotient and closures of rational images.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.M22.mk
api.statement: Construct the inverse system of finite component sets and its induced group where justified.

api.name: VanHoften24.M22.characterisation
api.statement: The adelic quotient uses the closure of the rational image.

api.name: VanHoften24.M22.map
api.statement: Level maps and Hecke actions induce the profinite transition and action.

uses.where: §3.4.1 pp34–35; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/M23
uses.how: Level maps and Hecke actions induce the profinite transition and action.

items.name: Local component quotient
items.statement: For the tamely ramified connected parahoric of Lemma3.4.2, G(Qp)/(rho Gsc(Qp)Gcal(Zp))≃(pi1(G)_I)^sigma via Kottwitz.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Generic component torsor
items.statement: The component set of the generic Shimura tower at fixed p-level is a torsor under the corresponding quotient of pi(G); the identification depends on a chosen connected component.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Very-special specialization of components
items.statement: At very special level under H, generic and geometric special fibers have canonically matching connected components, including the nonproper case in the source.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Component formula for isogeny parameters
items.statement: With a base point x at very special level, the component of the uniformized point represented by (y,g^p) is (kappa(y),g^p) acting on the component of x through R06 and M22.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Minimal KR stratum meets every component
items.statement: The zero-dimensional basic KR stratum tau at Iwahori level maps surjectively to connected components of the very-special Shimura variety.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Every KR stratum meets every component
items.statement: Each nonempty Iwahori KR stratum indexed by Adm(mu) maps surjectively to connected components of the very-special level variety.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Sigma-centralizer Kottwitz surjectivity
items.statement: For the basic class used in the zero KR stratum, the Kottwitz map J_b(Qp)→(pi1(G)_I)^sigma is surjective in the source connected-parahoric setting.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Auxiliary perfect Shimura fiber product
items.statement: For I⊂K very special and small U^p, define ShStar_I=Sh_K×_{Sht_K,mu}Sht_I,mu as a two-fiber product. Its natural map iota:Sh_I→ShStar_I comes from M15.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.C01.mk
api.statement: Construct the fiber product with its invertible comparison and two projections.

api.name: VanHoften24.C01.characterisation
api.statement: A point is a K-level point plus an I-level shtuka and an identification of their K-shtukas.

api.name: VanHoften24.C01.map
api.statement: Away-p Hecke and level transitions act on the fiber product.

uses.where: §4 p38; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C02, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C04, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C05, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C08, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C20
uses.how: Away-p Hecke and level transitions act on the fiber product.

items.name: Siegel level square
items.statement: The Siegel cube comparing integral lattice-chain models, height-one shtukas and parahoric changes is Cartesian in the setting of Lemma4.1.2.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Abelian quotient realization
items.statement: A p-power quasi-isogeny of the p-divisible group of an abelian scheme over a perfect base is realized by the corresponding abelian quotient with compatible polarization and prime-to-p level data, in RZ6.13’s setting.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Auxiliary map to Siegel model
items.statement: The Cartesian Siegel cube induces a morphism from ShStar_I to the chosen Siegel Iwahori model, compatible with the original Hodge embedding and the K-level maps.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Perfect proper point injection
items.statement: A perfectly proper pfp map of perfect spaces over Fpbar which is injective on geometric points is a closed immersion in the source setting.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Closed immersion into auxiliary model
items.statement: Under H, iota:Sh_I→ShStar_I is a closed immersion.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Affine auxiliary Siegel map
items.statement: The map ShStar_I→Siegel_I has a finite deperfection in the argument of Lemma4.1.6 and is therefore integral and affine, and perfectly finite. Ordinary finiteness of its perfection is not supplied by that argument.
items.locator: Lemma4.1.6 and footnote22 p39, corrected sufficient conclusion
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Injectivity in the auxiliary fiber
items.statement: The fiber map in Lemma4.1.7 is injective because the intersection of the positive loop subgroup for the Siegel chain with L+G_K is L+G_I, with full connected fixers.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Auxiliary weak smooth local-model map
items.statement: Under H and the smoothness input M07, lambdaHat:ShStar_I→[M_I^loc/G_I] is weakly perfectly smooth and ShStar_I is equidimensional of the same dimension as Sh_I.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Auxiliary KR strata
items.statement: For w∈Adm(mu), ShStar_I(w) is the inverse image of [M_I^loc(w)/G_I] under lambdaHat; ShStar_I(≤w) is the downward union.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.C09.mk
api.statement: Pull back each Schubert stratum through lambdaHat.

api.name: VanHoften24.C09.characterisation
api.statement: Openness of lambdaHat identifies the closure with the Bruhat downward union.

api.name: VanHoften24.C09.map
api.statement: Away-p Hecke maps preserve the strata and their closures.

uses.where: §4.2.2 p42; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C10, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C11, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C12, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C14, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C15
uses.how: Away-p Hecke maps preserve the strata and their closures.

items.name: Auxiliary KR dimensions
items.statement: For every w∈Adm(mu), ShStar_I(≤w) has dimension ell(w). The relative dimension of lambdaHat is dim G_I, not zero.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Normality of auxiliary KR closures
items.statement: For every w∈Adm(mu), ShStar_I(≤w) is normal.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Quasi-affineness of auxiliary KR strata
items.statement: Each ShStar_I(w) is quasi-affine. The Hodge line is ample after pullback along the affine map C06 and is torsion on the stratum.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Torsion ample line implies quasi-affineness
items.statement: For the qcqs perfect spaces in the source, an ample invertible sheaf of finite tensor order implies the space is quasi-affine; affineness of a pullback morphism preserves ampleness in the relevant ample-family criterion.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Minimal-EKOR incidence condition
items.statement: Conjecture4.3.1 is the predicate that every irreducible component of the closure of every EKOR stratum at very special level meets the zero-dimensional EKOR stratum tau. It remains a hypothesis when invoked abstractly.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.C13.mk
api.statement: Specify the incidence condition for all strata and their irreducible components.

api.name: VanHoften24.C13.characterisation
api.statement: The condition is stronger than merely having tau somewhere in the total special fiber.

api.name: VanHoften24.C13.map
api.statement: Pass to compatible finite away-p levels only using the incidence comparison.

uses.where: Conjecture4.3.1 p43; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C17, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C25
uses.how: Pass to compatible finite away-p levels only using the incidence comparison.

items.name: Proper incidence reaches zero KR stratum
items.statement: A connected component Z of a KR closure which meets a stratum with proper closure also meets the tau stratum.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Minimal intersection is straight
items.statement: For a minimal-length KR index x meeting a component in the incidence argument, x is sigma-straight.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Straight KR to EKOR finite-etale map
items.statement: For a sigma-straight x in the Iwahori argument there is y∈^K Adm(mu) of the same length and related by K-Weyl sigma-conjugacy such that ShStar_I(x)→Sh_K{y} is finite etale.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Incidence from the very-special conjecture
items.statement: Assuming C13, every irreducible component of every auxiliary KR closure meets the tau stratum.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Basic uniformization as perfect schemes
items.statement: Under the Hodge, tame, p-prime-derived-fundamental-group and connected very-special assumptions, the basic special fiber is I_x(Q) / (X(mu,b)_K×G(A_f^p)/U^p) as a perfect scheme, Hecke-equivariantly.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Basic quasi-isogeny inner form
items.statement: For a basic point under C18, I_x is an inner form of G, its p realization is J_b, its away-p realization is G, and I_x(R) is compact modulo center. The local identifications agree with the global inner twisting up to inner automorphism.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Basic auxiliary uniformization
items.statement: The basic locus of ShStar_I is I_x(Q) / (X(mu,b)_I×G(A_f^p)/U^p) as a perfect scheme, with its projection induced by the ADLV level map.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Simply connected action on minimal local fibers
items.statement: J_b^sc(Qp) acts transitively on the fibers of X(mu,b)_I(tau)→(pi1(G)_I)^sigma.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Abelianized degree-zero reductive cohomology
items.statement: For a reductive Q-group G define H^0_ab(Q,G)=H^0(Q,[Z(Gsc)→Z(G)]), with centers in degrees−1 and0, and ab^0:G(Q)→H^0_ab(Q,G). Use the crossed-module comparison [Gsc→G].
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.E01.mk
api.statement: Construct the center complex and its degree-zero hypercohomology.

api.name: VanHoften24.E01.characterisation
api.statement: Its comparison with the reductive crossed module gives the abelianization homomorphism.

api.name: VanHoften24.E01.map
api.statement: Inner-compatible isomorphisms of center complexes commute with localization.

uses.where: §4.3.12–4.3.15 pp47–49; Bor20 answer; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/E02
uses.how: Inner-compatible isomorphisms of center complexes commute with localization.

items.name: Degree-zero abelianization exactness
items.statement: The sequence Gsc(Q)→G(Q)→H^0_ab(Q,G)→H^1(Q,Gsc) is exact, with kernel of ab^0 equal to rho Gsc(Q).
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Real-positive image criterion
items.statement: Assume the Hasse principle ker(H^1(Q,Gsc)→H^1(R,Gsc))=1. Then G(Q)_+/rho Gsc(Q) identifies with the inverse image of ab^0(Z(G)(R)) under H^0_ab(Q,G)→H^0_ab(R,G).
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Inner-form equality of positive adelic images
items.statement: For inner Q-forms G,H with away-p identifications compatible with the fixed global inner twisting on the center complex, their positive rational images agree in G(A_f^p)/rho Gsc(A_f^p)×(pi1(G)_I)^sigma.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Hecke transitivity on zero-stratum fibers
items.statement: For finite Sigma containing p in the source setting, Gsc(A_f^Sigma) acts transitively on the fibers of ShStar_I(tau)→pi0(Sh_K), at the compatible away-p tower.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Hecke transitivity on KR components
items.statement: If the Shimura variety is proper or C13 holds, Gsc(A_f^Sigma) acts transitively on the fibers of pi0(ShStar_I(≤w))→pi0(Sh_K).
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Global Cartesian square theorem
items.statement: Under H, if the Shimura variety is proper or C13 holds, iota:Sh_I→ShStar_I is an isomorphism.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Hyperspecial minimal-incidence theorem
items.statement: When G_Qp is unramified and K hyperspecial, the incidence predicate C13 holds by the WZ18/And21 results invoked here.
items.locator: Remarks4.3.2–4.3.3 p43; proof main results p52
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: General-parahoric isogeny uniformization
items.statement: Under H, if G_Qp is unramified or Sh is proper, the orbit set M18 bijects with the isogeny class of x at every parahoric level, compatibly with away-p Hecke and Frobenius.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: He–Rapoport axioms
items.statement: Under the hypotheses of C26, the integral models satisfy the He–Rapoport axioms, including the remaining level-change surjectivity axiom4(c), in the numbering used by the source.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Q-nonbasic Newton class
items.statement: A class b∈B(G_Qp) is Q-nonbasic if its image in every Q-simple adjoint factor of G is nonbasic. An EKOR stratum intersects the Q-nonbasic locus if it has a point of such a class.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.C28.mk
api.statement: Project b to each Q-simple adjoint factor and require nonbasicness there.

api.name: VanHoften24.C28.characterisation
api.statement: For Q-simple Gad this reduces to ordinary nonbasicness.

api.name: VanHoften24.C28.map
api.statement: The predicate is compatible with an isomorphism of the Q-adjoint datum.

uses.where: §4.5.1 p52; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C30, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/C32
uses.how: The predicate is compatible with an isomorphism of the Q-adjoint datum.

items.name: KR-to-EKOR surjectivity
items.statement: For w∈^K Adm(mu), the Iwahori KR stratum Sh_I(w) maps surjectively onto the very-special EKOR stratum Sh_K{w}, under the hypotheses giving He–Rapoport axiom4(c).
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Straight Q-nonbasic stratum components
items.statement: Under H and properness or C13, for sigma-straight w whose EKOR stratum is Q-nonbasic, pi0(Sh_K{w})→pi0(Sh_K) is bijective.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: General Q-nonbasic EKOR components
items.statement: Under H, at very special K and assuming properness or C13, if Sh_K{w} intersects the Q-nonbasic locus then its connected components map bijectively to those of Sh_K.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: EKOR component theorem for Q-simple adjoint group
items.statement: Under H, Gad Q-simple, K very special, and properness or unramified G_Qp, an EKOR stratum not contained in the smallest Newton stratum has the same connected-component set as the Shimura variety.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Saturated Iwahori preimage at very special level
items.statement: Under V set Adm(mu)^K=WK Adm(mu) WK and X(mu,b)^K=union_{w∈Adm(mu)^K}X_w(b) inside the Iwahori flag space. This is the full inverse image of X(mu,b)_K, generally larger than X(mu,b)_I.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.A01.mk
api.statement: Form the two-sided saturation and its Iwahori ADLV union.

api.name: VanHoften24.A01.characterisation
api.statement: Its projection to Gr_K is exactly the original bounded ADLV.

api.name: VanHoften24.A01.map
api.statement: J_b action and level projection respect the saturation.

uses.where: AppendixA1 p54; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A02, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A12
uses.how: J_b action and level projection respect the saturation.

items.name: Flag fibration preserves connected components
items.statement: Under V the projection X(mu,b)^K→X(mu,b)_K is an etale-locally trivial flag fibration with connected fibers and induces a J_b(Qp)-equivariant bijection on pi0.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Echelonnage root datum and corrected dominance
items.statement: For a very special vertex, the reduced echelonnage root system Sigma has Waff≃W(Sigma)⋉Qvee(Sigma). On dominant inertia cocharacters lambda≤lambdaPrime means lambdaPrime−lambda is a nonnegative integral sum of positive coroots.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.V01.mk
api.statement: Construct Sigma and identify its affine Weyl group with the chosen parahoric root datum.

api.name: VanHoften24.V01.characterisation
api.statement: The positive-coroot cone points from smaller to larger dominant cocharacters.

api.name: VanHoften24.V01.map
api.statement: Sigma, sigma, Levi subsets and cocharacter lattices are transported together.

uses.where: AppendixA1 p54, corrected order; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A01, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A03, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/R07, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A11, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A13, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A14, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/R08, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A18, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A19
uses.how: Sigma, sigma, Levi subsets and cocharacter lattices are transported together.

items.name: Newton Levi and admissible Levi parameters
items.statement: Under V choose b in M=Z_G(nu_b), basic in M. For x∈pi1(M)_I let mu_x be its unique M-dominant M-minuscule representative. Let I_mu,b,M consist of x with image kappa_M([b]) in pi1(M)_Gamma and mu_x≤mu. Explicitly project inertia coinvariants to sigma coinvariants.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.A03.mk
api.statement: Choose the dominant Newton representative and form its centralizer Levi and parameter set.

api.name: VanHoften24.A03.characterisation
api.statement: The length-zero element tau_x=t^(mu_x)w_x identifies x with the M-minuscule representative.

api.name: VanHoften24.A03.map
api.statement: Levi inclusion gives X_M(mu_x,b)_K_M→X_G(mu,b)_K.

uses.where: AppendixA1.1 pp54–55; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A04, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A06, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A10, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A13, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A14, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A16, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A24, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A26
uses.how: Levi inclusion gives X_M(mu_x,b)_K_M→X_G(mu,b)_K.

items.name: Union of Levi images meets all components
items.statement: Under V, the union over lambda∈I_mu,b,M of pi0(X_M(lambda,b)_K_M)→pi0(X_G(mu,b)_K) is surjective.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Every individual Levi image meets all components
items.statement: Under V, for every lambda∈I_mu,b,M, pi0(X_M(lambda,b)_K_M)→pi0(X_G(mu,b)_K) is surjective.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Independence of Levi component image
items.statement: Under V the image on pi0 of X_M(lambda,b)_K_M→X_G(mu,b)_K is independent of lambda∈I_mu,b,M.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Transitivity on ADLV connected components
items.statement: Under V the group J_b(Qp) acts transitively on pi0(X(mu,b)_K).
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Sigma-straight affine Weyl element
items.statement: An element w∈Wtilde is sigma-straight when ell(w sigma(w)…sigma^(n−1)(w))=n ell(w) for all positive n, equivalently ell(w)=<2rho,nu_w> with the dominant Newton representative and source hypotheses.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.A08.mk
api.statement: Define the iterated sigma product and its length growth.

api.name: VanHoften24.A08.characterisation
api.statement: Compare the growth condition with the Newton pairing in the specified affine root datum.

api.name: VanHoften24.A08.map
api.statement: Sigma-conjugacy transport preserves the straight-class invariant in its valid form.

uses.where: AppendixA2.1 p56; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A09, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A10
uses.how: Sigma-conjugacy transport preserves the straight-class invariant in its valid form.

items.name: Straight class classification
items.statement: Straight sigma-conjugacy classes in Wtilde map bijectively to B(G) through the Kottwitz and Newton invariants in the setting of AppendixA2.1.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Straight element in the Newton Levi
items.statement: For straight w with class [b], let u∈^J W0 be the minimal representative taking nu_w to its dominant Newton point nu_b, and set wsharp=u w sigma(u)^(-1). Then wsharp∈Omega_M for M=Z_G(nu_b).
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Levi fundamental-group kernel
items.statement: For a standard Galois-stable Levi M, ker(pi1(M)→pi1(G)) is the lattice generated by the classes of simple coroots of G outside M. With the relevant finite Galois action it is a permutation lattice; verify exactness after inertia and Frobenius coinvariants before using torsion-freeness.
items.locator: Proof PropositionA1.6 p57, corrected roots and coinvariant qualification
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Rank-one perfect projective curve
items.statement: An affine-root quotient U_alpha/U_alpha+ of dimension1 and a chosen lift f_alpha give h_alpha(a)=f_alpha([a]) over perfect k-algebras. The induced affine-line map to the ind-projective flag space extends to P1^perf and has the opposite-root endpoint s_alpha I.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.A11.mk
api.statement: Choose the root-quotient lift and compose with the Teichmuller section.

api.name: VanHoften24.A11.characterisation
api.statement: The rank-one Bruhat identity computes h_-alpha(infinity)=s_alpha I.

api.name: VanHoften24.A11.map
api.statement: Translate the curve by a loop element and compare its endpoints.

uses.where: Proof PropositionA1.6 pp57–58; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A04, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A12, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A17
uses.how: Translate the curve by a loop element and compare its endpoints.

items.name: Root curve stays in the saturated bound
items.statement: In the reduced-word construction of PropositionA1.6, each rank-one curve has relative position among wi, s wi, wi sigma(s), s wi sigma(s). These all belong to WK Adm(mu) WK.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Unramified comparison of root combinatorics
items.statement: For the adjoint root data reduced to in A3, there is an unramified quasi-split comparison group whose echelonnage datum, sigma, cocharacter lattice, Levi subset, mu and Kottwitz data identify with those of G. This transports the combinatorial statements, not the geometric root groups.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Levi root relations
items.statement: For x,xprime∈I_mu,b,M, a relation indexed by alpha∈Sigma and r>0 has xprime−x=alphaVee−sigma^r(alphaVee), and mu_x, mu_x+alphaVee, mu_x−sigma^r(alphaVee), mu_xprime≤mu. It is irreducible if neither of the two displayed intermediate parameters x+alphaVee−sigma^i(alphaVee) and x+sigma^i(alphaVee)−sigma^r(alphaVee) supplies a two-step relation for any 0<i<r. The first sign is corrected from the printed A3.3.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.A14.mk
api.statement: Supply alpha,r, the lattice difference and each of the four stated dominance inequalities.

api.name: VanHoften24.A14.characterisation
api.statement: Irreducibility excludes the two shorter intermediate relations of A3.3.

api.name: VanHoften24.A14.map
api.statement: Transport the relation under the root-data identification A13.

uses.where: AppendixA3.3 p59; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A06, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A15, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A20, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A21, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A29
uses.how: Transport the relation under the root-data identification A13.

items.name: Chains of Levi root relations
items.statement: Any two parameters in I_mu,b,M are linked by relations with alpha outside M, alphaVee M-dominant and M-minuscule; if h is the number of connected components of Sigma, orbit length is h,2h or3h and r obeys the bounds of LemmaA3.4.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Weak dominance of Levi parameters
items.statement: For each mu_x in I_mu,b,M, the inequalities <beta,mu_x>≥−1 for the relevant positive roots provide the weak-dominance input used in the extension of Nie7.7.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Rank-one subgroup for a relative root
items.statement: Choose the short relative root above an echelonnage root. Its rank-one subgroup is a restriction of scalars of SL2 in the nonmultipliable case or SU3 in the multipliable case; keep the root-field and ramified quadratic extension data.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.R08.mk
api.statement: Construct the root-field subgroup and its embedding into G.

api.name: VanHoften24.R08.characterisation
api.statement: Identify the relevant rank-one root subgroups and valuation parameters.

api.name: VanHoften24.R08.map
api.statement: Transport its root elements through the chosen embedding.

uses.where: AppendixA3.5–A3.6 pp60–61; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/R09
uses.how: Transport its root elements through the chosen embedding.

items.name: Unitary root coordinates
items.statement: For a quadratic extension Kprime/K with involution tau and anti-diagonal Hermitian form, u_i(c,d)=I+g has g_(-i,0)=−tau(c), g_(0,i)=c, g_(-i,i)=d. It lies in SU3 when tau(c)c+d+tau(d)=0.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.R09.mk
api.statement: Supply c,d satisfying the unitary equation and form the indicated matrix.

api.name: VanHoften24.R09.characterisation
api.statement: The equation is exactly the nontrivial Hermitian-preservation entry; determinant is1.

api.name: VanHoften24.R09.map
api.statement: The involution and field embeddings transport the matrix and its constraint.

uses.where: AppendixA3.6 pp60–61; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A17
uses.how: The involution and field embeddings transport the matrix and its constraint.

items.name: Three root-curve models
items.statement: In the p>2 tame setting needed by A4, use SL2 f_alpha(pi^(-1)[a]); standard SU3 u_1(0,pi^(-1)[a]) with tau(pi)=−pi; and nonstandard SU3 u_1([a],−[a]²/2). Keep the two very-special parahoric choices.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.A17.mk
api.statement: Choose the rank-one case, lattice type and anti-invariant uniformizer.

api.name: VanHoften24.A17.characterisation
api.statement: Each formula lies in the correct root group and defines the required perfect affine-line map.

api.name: VanHoften24.A17.map
api.statement: Embed it into LG and project to Gr_K, compatibly with perfect base change.

uses.where: AppendixA3.7 p61, corrected unitary sign; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A18, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A19, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A20, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A21
uses.how: Embed it into LG and project to Gr_K, compatibly with perfect base change.

items.name: Rank-two bounded double-coset estimate
items.statement: For roots alpha,beta generating A2, A1×A1 or A1 and cocharacters lambda,delta satisfying delta,delta+alphaVee,delta−betaVee,delta+alphaVee−betaVee≤lambda, u_alpha(z)t^delta u_beta(y) belongs to the union of L+G t^lambdaPrime L+G for lambdaPrime≤lambda, in the source rank-one coordinate setting.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Integral rank-two conjugate
items.statement: If <alpha,betaVee>=<beta,alphaVee>=−1 and <alpha,lambda>≥2, then u_beta(z)(t^lambda u_alpha(y)t^(-lambda))u_beta(−z) lies in L+G for all y,z∈k, in the source coordinate setting.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Root curve for a short orbit segment
