items.statement: For an irreducible relation x→xprime as in LemmaA3.11 with 1≤r≤h and P∈X_M(mu_x,b), there is Pprime∈X_M(mu_xprime,b) in the same G-ADLV component with kappa_M(P)−kappa_M(Pprime)=sum_{i=0}^{r−1}sigma^i(alphaVee).
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Triality curve correction
items.statement: In the length-3h orbit case with r>h, use the two cases from Nie7.8. In the adjacent D4 branch reverse the root-product order as prescribed and apply A19 to the noncommuting terms to keep the curve in the bound. The result has the same connected-component and Kottwitz-displacement conclusion as A20, now for h<r≤2h−1.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Good isogeny-map locus
items.statement: Under the Hodge hypotheses of AppendixA4 (p>2,tame quasi-split,p-prime pi1der and connected very-special K), X(mu,b)_K^good is the locus of ADLV points whose Siegel Dieudonné image lifts to the Hodge model with the required crystalline tensors.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.A22.mk
api.statement: Supply the tensor-preserving lift of the associated Siegel point.

api.name: VanHoften24.A22.characterisation
api.statement: The good locus is defined by the normalization branch and tensor condition.

api.name: VanHoften24.A22.map
api.statement: It is stable under the compatible tensor quasi-isogenies and reflex Frobenius.

uses.where: AppendixA4.1–A4.3 pp63–65; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A23
uses.how: It is stable under the compatible tensor quasi-isogenies and reflex Frobenius.

items.name: Good locus is a union of components
items.statement: Under AppendixA4 hypotheses, X(mu,b)_K^good is a union of connected components of X(mu,b)_K.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Adapted Newton-Levi lift
items.statement: For a suitable point with b=tau_lambda in the Newton Levi, choose an M-valued Hodge cocharacter mu_y and an (M,mu_y)-adapted lift of its p-divisible group, over the ring of integers of a finite extension, with the prescribed tensors.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

api.name: VanHoften24.A24.mk
api.statement: Supply the tensor p-divisible group, M-cocharacter filtration and adapted integral lift.

api.name: VanHoften24.A24.characterisation
api.statement: Reduction returns the original Frobenius module and tensors.

api.name: VanHoften24.A24.map
api.statement: Rational M(Qp) modifications induce the corresponding Levi ADLV points.

uses.where: Proof PropositionA4.3 pp64–65; Zhou20 Definition4.6; consumers PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A25, PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24/A26
uses.how: Rational M(Qp) modifications induce the corresponding Levi ADLV points.

items.name: Adapted-lift existence input
items.statement: In the setting of AppendixA4.3, Zhou6.11 and its Assumption5.12 produce the required M-valued Hodge filtration and adapted lift.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Rational Levi modifications meet its components
items.statement: The map M(Qp)/Mcal(Zp)→X_M(lambda,b)_K_M obtained from an adapted lift lands in the good locus and induces a surjection on connected components.
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Very-special isogeny map
items.statement: Under AppendixA4 hypotheses, the Siegel Dieudonné map uniquely lifts to i_x:X(mu,b)_K(Fpbar)→S_K(G,X)(Fpbar), preserving crystalline tensors and commuting with Phi=(b sigma)^r. It yields the I_x(Q)-orbit bijection M18 onto the isogeny class, equivariant for G(A_f^p).
items.locator: PropositionA4.3 and TheoremA4.5(1) pp64–65; main Theorem2(1)
items.note: The specialized statement was not found in the pinned trees. A prior paper candidate is ownership evidence only; it is not a completed atlas stage or implementation.

items.name: Very-special CM reduction theorem
items.statement: Under AppendixA4 hypotheses, every isogeny class at connected very-special level contains a point which is the reduction of a special point of the generic Shimura variety.
